displayTitleRules: Use a concise professional title that describes the subject or outcome.
Do not prefix the title with Obserra, Obserra Academy, a department name, a price tier, or a version number.
Preserve accepted acronyms and technical names such as AI, API, CISO, LLM, DevSecOps, Zero Trust, and EIOS where appropriate.
Use the exact canonical title unchanged across catalog, website, learner player, owner review, checkout description, completion record, and certificate.
stableIdRules: Stable after first publication unless an explicit migration preserves historical aliases and records.
Do not encode price, level, version, or learner information into the stable ID.
